newsitem.title: USA: CMS gas unit '96 revenues rise.
newsitem.headline: CMS gas unit '96 revenues rise.

text.p: CMS Energy Corp said Wednesday its Consumers Gas Group subsidiary had record operating revenue of $1.28 billion for 1996, a seven percent increase over all of 1995.

The company attributed the increase to an 11 percent rise in natural gas deliveries for 1996, and higher revenue from value-added products and services. Slightly cooler weather in 1996 accounted for about $0.31 a share of 1996 earnings.
Consumers Gas is comprised of CMS' Consumers Energy natural gas utility and storage businesses. Financial performance of the unit is tied to CMS Class G stock, traded under the symbol CPG.N.

Consumers Gas earned $15 million or $0.44 a share in the 1996 fourth quarter, down from $18 million or $0.55 a year ago, due in part to a write-down of its idled Marysville, Mich., synthetic gas plant. Fourth quarter operating revenue was $402 million, up from $394 million.
For the year, net income was $59 million or $1.82, down from pro-forma earnings for 1995 of $62 million or $1.93. The year-ago results included a one-time $15 million gain.
